models.name: multi_user_todo_guests
models.description:
Stores guest actor records for anonymous access.

A guest is correlated to a device-level identity (e.g., a fingerprint generated on the client) and has no password credentials. The guest record is used to associate guest browsing sessions and todo interactions (within the guest access boundaries defined by the system). Soft deletion is supported via deleted_at; sessions and related records are handled by dedicated session tables.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Client-generated device fingerprint used to correlate a guest identity across requests while the user remains unauthenticated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the guest actor record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the guest actor record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the guest actor record was soft-deleted. Null means the guest is active.

models.name: multi_user_todo_guest_sessions
models.description:
Guest session tokens for temporary guest access. This table stores issued session credentials and connection metadata for unauthenticated (guest) usage, and expires sessions for security auditing.

Each record belongs to exactly one guest account ({@link multi_user_todo_guests.id}).

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address where the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL (href) the client visited when creating the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer information sent by the client when creating the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the guest session.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the guest session record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for the guest session record.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp of the guest session. Sessions become invalid after this time.

models.name: multi_user_todo_members
models.description:
Member actor identity for registered users who can authenticate to the multi_user_todo system.

This table stores the canonical account credentials (email-based identity and password hash) used by the authentication flow. Private profile data and todo ownership are modeled in other domain tables and referenced from this actor identity.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used to identify the member account during registration and login.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password credential for secure authentication. Store only the hash, never the plaintext password.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp. Null when the account is active; set when the account is deleted.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_sessions
models.description:
Authenticated member login sessions that store token-related connection metadata.

Each record represents one active/issued session for a specific authenticated member and is referenced by session-protected todo and profile operations.

This table supports the session persistence requirements by keeping connection context (IP, href, referrer) and an expiration timestamp for security enforcement.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address captured when the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The request URL (href) captured when the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The HTTP referrer URL captured when the session was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the session record was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When the session becomes invalid for authentication.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens for member accounts.

When a member requests password recovery, a token is issued and can be validated until its expiration timestamp. The token is associated with exactly one owning member ({@link multi_user_todo_members.id}).

This table is append-focused: use created_at/updated_at for audit, and deleted_at for soft deletion when a token is invalidated or no longer needed.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member that this password reset token targets ({@link multi_user_todo_members.id}).

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque password reset token used by the client to prove the request. Stored as a generated token value.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which this reset token is no longer valid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for invalidated or purged reset tokens.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for member accounts to confirm ownership of an email address after registration or when the email changes. Each record belongs to exactly one {@link multi_user_todo_members.id} (the target member) and expires at a specified time.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member account {@link multi_user_todo_members.id}. This token is issued for a specific member.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque verification token value presented by the client and redeemed by the backend to verify the member email ownership.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: The email address that this token is intended to verify for the member at the time of issuance.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address captured at token issuance time for basic auditing and troubleshooting.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Link or URL reference associated with this verification token (e.g., the verification endpoint URL embedded into the email).

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer information captured at token issuance time for auditing the request origin.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this verification token record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this verification token record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the token is considered revoked/invalid for verification purposes.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration time for this token. After this timestamp, the token must be treated as invalid.

models.name: multi_user_todo_user_profiles
models.description: Stores the private user profile identity for the owning member. Contains the editable display name used for personal customization while preserving a strict privacy boundary so other users cannot access this profile’s private data.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User-customized display name for personalization and human-friendly labeling within the user’s private scope.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the profile is considered unavailable until restored (if the application supports restore).

models.name: multi_user_todo_user_profile_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time audit records for a member’s private user profile.

Each snapshot captures the display name (and any other current profile attributes required to reconstruct the past state) at the moment the profile was changed. Snapshots support recovery/retention behavior by preserving historical profile values even after subsequent edits and after soft-deletion of the owning profile data is initiated.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member (owner of the profile) {@link multi_user_todo_members.id}.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: The member’s display name captured at the time of this profile snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of this profile snapshot record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this snapshot record (typically unchanged after creation).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for this snapshot record (nullable).

models.name: multi_user_todo_edit_history_entries
models.description: Audit entries created for each edit action on a todo. Each entry belongs to exactly one todo and records when the edit occurred; the per-field changes are stored in {@link multi_user_todo_edit_history_entry_changes} to keep this table normalized and atomic.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged todo for which this edit history entry was created, {@link multi_user_todo_edit_history_entries.id}.

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: Business timestamp of when the todo was edited (required for ordering edit history entries newest to oldest).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for this edit history entry.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp for this edit history entry.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When the todo is permanently deleted from trash, this entry is also removed from permanently deleted content.

models.name: multi_user_todo_edit_history_entry_changes
models.description:
Stores per-field change markers for a specific {@link multi_user_todo_edit_history_entries} record.

Each row captures one todo attribute that was actually changed by an edit action, along with the prior value (from_value) and the updated value (to_value) for that field. This table exists to represent edit history in a normalized, field-granular way without relying on nullable columns for optional entities.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_edit_history_entry_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged todo edit history entry {@link multi_user_todo_edit_history_entries.id}.

plainFields.name: changed_field
plainFields.description: The name of the todo field that changed (e.g., title, description, start_date, due_date).

plainFields.name: from_value
plainFields.description: The previous value of the changed field before the edit. Null represents that the value was absent before the edit.

plainFields.name: to_value
plainFields.description: The new value of the changed field after the edit. Null represents that the value became absent after the edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this field-level edit change record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this field-level edit change record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp. When set, the record is considered deleted but still kept for audit recovery.
